axes: FBX axis_forward=-Z axis_up=Y, same as bear.fbx. Blender: up +Z, front -Y, 1 unit = 1 stud. The egg stands on the origin (base centre at 0,0,0), its long axis is +Y in Roblox.

conversions.scaleNote: As for the Bear: Studio's default FBX units import these at 100x. Set Size = MeshSize/100 (or use sizeStuds below). centerFromEggBase is where each MeshPart's centre goes, relative to the egg's base centre, at 1x.

meshes.name: Egg__TopShell
meshes.role: top shell: pops up on Hatch
meshes.material: SurfaceAppearance (ColorMap = the type's texture, RoughnessMap = egg-roughness.png)
meshes.note: Has an inner skin and a cut rim, so it is solid from below when it lifts.

meshes.name: Egg__BottomShell
meshes.role: bottom shell: the cup that stays
meshes.material: SurfaceAppearance (same maps as the top shell)

meshes.name: Egg__Core
meshes.note: Sits behind the seam. Lifting the top shell 0.04 studs shows it through the crack.

uv.outer: u round the egg (u = 0.5 is the front), v 0.08..1 from bottom pole to top pole
uv.note: Both shells and every type share this layout, so a type swap is one ColorMap swap.

egg.roughnessPlan: Glossy toy plastic: roughness 0.27 outside, 0.78 inside the shell. No MetalnessMap, no NormalMap. If SurfaceAppearance is too costly in the ViewportFrame, use the ColorMap as MeshPart.TextureID with Material SmoothPlastic and Reflectance 0.08.

companion.name: Companion Egg
companion.look: warm cream shell, big royal-blue polka dots, one lime ribbon round the belly

toy.name: Toy Egg
toy.look: sunny yellow toy plastic, two bouncing teal wave stripes, coral and white dots

material.name: Material Egg
material.look: polished lavender marble with teal and blue veins and a pearly sheen

hue.name: Hue Egg
hue.look: candy rainbow swirl: pink, yellow, teal, blue and violet ribbons spiralling up the shell

feature.name: Feature Egg
feature.look: deep plum night-sky shell fading to lavender, mint and white four-point stars, fine glitter

star.name: StarToken
star.pivot: mesh centre; the star faces the camera along -Z in the FBX (front +Z at runtime)
star.uv: planar from the front, mirrored on the back, so both faces show the same facets
star.missedRound: same mesh, Transparency 0.6, Color #DDE7EE, no ColorMap tint change needed (spec 2.4)
